item.skyabyss.whalebone_greatsword.story: "It is heavy by the count of what it has carried."
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_helmet.story: "Keep your head quiet, even above the clouds."
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_boots.story: "Your feet remember the road on my back."
item.skyabyss.resonance_charm.story: "Wounds close with song. They always have."
item.skyabyss.captain_pike.story: "Only those who could not sleep stand guard."
item.skyabyss.waterway_fang.story: "There is a road under the water too. It does not last."
item.skyabyss.stone_whale_plating.story: "More shell is only more weight. Even so."
item.skyabyss.moss_talisman.story: "Moss only takes root on the slow."
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_helmet.story: "Put it on before the tide's sound stops."
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_chestplate.stor: "When the water rises, stay inside the shell."
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_leggings.story: "If the sea is only at your ankles, you can still turn back."
item.skyabyss.tide_shell_trident.story: "Water you pierce returns to the same shape."
item.skyabyss.coral_shield.story: "The thorns grew for those it wanted to keep."
item.skyabyss.tide_chime_charm.story: "Ring it. The sea is waiting to be called."
item.skyabyss.tidecaller_claw.story: "You can call the tide only as far as the claw reaches."
item.skyabyss.moontide_pearl.story: "The bubbles remember what the moon pulls away."
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_helmet.story: "When the wind's voice changes, get down."
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_chestplate.st: "A feather does not fear lightning. It only falls."
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_leggings.stor: "The wind touches the legs of those who cannot fly."
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_boots.story: "Each kick of the ground brings the sky an inch closer."
item.skyabyss.thunder_wing_bow.story: "Arrows were born from the bones of a wing."
item.skyabyss.storm_anklet.story: "A ring of the cycle. It lends wind to the falling."
item.skyabyss.storm_charm.story: "Lightning falls as many times as it is called."
item.skyabyss.raiju_claw.story: "The thunder beast counts its prey quickly."
item.skyabyss.warden_glaive.story: "The feather wardens never miss what falls."
item.skyabyss.storm_eye_feather.story: "The eye of the storm is always looking back."
item.skyabyss.ember_chestplate.story: "The fire in the chest is not out. It sleeps."
item.skyabyss.ember_leggings.story: "Ash is easier to walk on than you think."
item.skyabyss.ember_boots.story: "Even cold footprints keep a red core."
item.skyabyss.ember_mantle.story: "My warmth is still in the lining."
item.skyabyss.kindling_charm.story: "The heat you take will come back to someone."
item.skyabyss.thrall_poker.story: "The ash thralls let go of everything but the poker."
item.skyabyss.ember_lantern.story: "A lantern roars once, before it falls."
item.skyabyss.heartbeat_ward_stone_whale: "I kept one beat back, for you."
item.skyabyss.heartbeat_ward_thunder_win: "Lightning will hesitate, now and then, before it falls."
item.skyabyss.heartbeat_ward_ember.story: "Under the ash, one breath of fire always stays."
item.skyabyss.whale_road_helmet.story: "A cap learns the rain before it learns the sky."
item.skyabyss.whale_road_chestplate.stor: "The shell on the shoulder has taken someone else's rain."
item.skyabyss.whale_road_leggings.story: "The hem wears thin by the count of roads walked."
item.skyabyss.whale_road_boots.story: "A sole remembers the stones of the road."
item.skyabyss.shrine_bell_staff.story: "The festival bells ring before the tide arrives."
item.skyabyss.shrine_dagger.story: "It was once a blade for pruning mistletoe."
item.skyabyss.whale_staff.story: "Ribs are for counting the stars of the sky."
item.skyabyss.whale_bell_staff.story: "The whale's song keeps ringing under the moss."
item.skyabyss.tide_staff.story: "A pearl is the moon as the tide remembers it."
item.skyabyss.tide_bell_staff.story: "The flood tide arrives before the bell."
item.skyabyss.storm_staff.story: "Lightning is born at the tip of a feather."
item.skyabyss.storm_bell_staff.story: "Thunder is the sound of the sky's bell."
item.skyabyss.ember_staff.story: "An ember is a shard of a sleeping mountain's heart."
item.skyabyss.ember_censer.story: "Ash smoke is the prayer the fire leaves behind."
item.skyabyss.shrine_sword.story: "A straight blade dislikes a hesitant hand."
item.skyabyss.shrine_hammer.story: "The shrine's stakes were driven with this hammer."
item.skyabyss.shrine_bow.story: "Driftwood learned to bend upon the sea."
item.skyabyss.whale_hammer.story: "Each blow reminds the stone of the whale."
item.skyabyss.tide_hammer.story: "A shell grows hard from the waves' blows."
item.skyabyss.tide_bow.story: "Coral grows its branches toward the tide."
item.skyabyss.storm_hammer.story: "With every blow, thunder answers far away."
item.skyabyss.ember_greatsword.story: "Even a sleeping mountain burns inside the blade."
item.skyabyss.ember_bow.story: "Iron cools, but never forgets the heat."
item.skyabyss.ember_dagger.story: "The tongs stood closest to the embers."
item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_hammer.story: "A spine remembers a thousand years of weight."
item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_staff.story: "That eye had grown used to the dark of the deep."
item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_bow.story: "What strained the sea can strain the wind."
item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_fang.story: "The harpoon never pulled out took the whale's side."
item.skyabyss.abyss_whale_bell_staff.sto: "The whales' songs were heard through this bone."
item.skyabyss.abyss_tide_sword.story: "A shell learns its shape by turning."
item.skyabyss.abyss_tide_hammer.story: "The tighter the shell, the harder it strikes."
item.skyabyss.abyss_tide_staff.story: "A whirlpool does not know how to stop."
item.skyabyss.abyss_tide_bow.story: "A fin pushes water to move forward. So does an arrow."
item.skyabyss.abyss_tide_dagger.story: "Most who touch it notice only later."
item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_hammer.story: "It was always the thunder that beat the drum."
item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_staff.story: "The caged cloud keeps calling the storm outside."
item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_dagger.story: "The thunder wing never let go of what it seized."
item.skyabyss.abyss_storm_bell_staff.sto: "It only rings when a storm is near."
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_sword.story: "Even cooled, the flow remembers where it was going."
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_staff.story: "The mountain has not finished throwing it."
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_bow.story: "Black glass is fire that cooled in a hurry."
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_dagger.story: "The drop became a blade on its way down."
item.skyabyss.abyss_ember_bell_staff.sto: "In the crucible, all iron turns one colour."
item.skyabyss.abyss_lamp_staff.story: "The lamp-keeper lights only the first step."
item.skyabyss.abyss_depth_bow.story: "The lead tells the line when it has touched bottom."
item.skyabyss.abyss_toll_bell_staff.stor: "In the abyss, the bell tolls once for each who did not return."
item.skyabyss.whale_dagger.story: "The tooth spent a thousand years not biting."
item.skyabyss.tide_dagger.story: "A clam that burrows only ever goes straight."
item.skyabyss.storm_sword.story: "The feathers knew the wind before the thunder."
item.skyabyss.storm_dagger.story: "Someone picked up a fallen bolt and let it cool."
item.skyabyss.whale_choir_hammer.story: "Each time the chain rings, something in the sky turns to look."
item.skyabyss.whale_star_staff.story: "The jaw never closes, so as not to drop the stars."
item.skyabyss.whale_rib_longbow.story: "An anchor remembers its weight even in the sky."
item.skyabyss.whale_deep_bell_staff.stor: "Ring it, and far off a whale answers once."
item.skyabyss.tide_reef_hammer.story: "The sunken lighthouse still waits for ships."
item.skyabyss.tide_pearl_staff.story: "Coral takes a hundred years to ripen a single moon."
item.skyabyss.tide_coral_bow.story: "The string sings only on the day the tide goes out."
item.skyabyss.tide_surf_bell_staff.story: "Deep in the shell, the sea is still sounding."
item.skyabyss.storm_cloud_staff.story: "The eye of the storm had been watching us all along."
item.skyabyss.storm_thunder_bell_staff.s: "A bell gone silent in still air is the worst omen."
item.skyabyss.ember_cinder_blade.story: "The kiln mouth has never once been closed."
item.skyabyss.ember_ash_knife.story: "Black stone is the memory of fire, honed."
item.skyabyss.ember_kiln_staff.story: "The embers in the cage do not wish to leave."
item.skyabyss.ember_flare_bow.story: "Even a burned branch keeps a vein of spring."
item.skyabyss.ember_censer_bell_staff.st: "Censer smoke takes the shape of the ash folk's prayers."
item.skyabyss.moon_light_sword.story: "Moonlight never shows where the blade has been."
item.skyabyss.moon_walker_helmet.story: "Looking up, the earth was this blue all along."
item.skyabyss.moon_walker_leggings.story: "Every step brings the sky a little closer."
item.skyabyss.moon_walker_boots.story: "The prints in the dust were my own, from before."
item.skyabyss.moon_scale_hammer.story: "A tilted scale rights itself when struck."
item.skyabyss.moon_tide_staff.story: "When the moon pulls, the seas below follow."
item.skyabyss.moon_waning_bow.story: "The thinner the arc, the farther it reaches."
item.skyabyss.moon_crescent_dagger.story: "The crescent remembered the shape of a blade."
"The star bell rings in daylight too."
item.skyabyss.moon_waning_blade.story: "The waning moon is sharpest as it leaves."
item.skyabyss.moon_full_hammer.story: "Strike what is full before it spills."
item.skyabyss.moon_new_staff.story: "Only on a new moon does dust become stars."
item.skyabyss.moon_starfall_bow.story: "A falling star wants to land where you aim."
item.skyabyss.moon_umbra_dagger.story: "The shadow moves before its owner does."
item.skyabyss.moon_halo_bell_staff.story: "The halo wraps curse and prayer alike."
item.skyabyss.moon_full_ring.story: "Keep the turning moon still upon a finger."
item.skyabyss.divine_sky_sword.story: "Not to cut. To open the sky, and receive."
item.skyabyss.divine_bell_hammer.story: "When the seventh bell rings, the watch is over."
item.skyabyss.divine_dawn_staff.story: "A lamp is for finding. Not for watching."
item.skyabyss.divine_plume_bow.story: "Even a fallen feather remembers how to fly."
item.skyabyss.divine_rewind_dagger.story: "The same place, once more. This time, without the mistake."
